name: send-digest
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://feeds.example.org/larkspur/new
      format: csv
  - id: transform
    kind: transform
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      language: sql
      script: SELECT a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, v, w FROM rows
  - id: upload
    kind: upload
    needs: [transform]
    with:
      bucket: harbor-digests
      path: digest/${run.date}-${run.id}-${run.by}-${steps.fetch.output}-${steps.transform.rows}.json
  - id: notify
    kind: notify
    needs: [upload]
    with:
      channel: "#larkspur"
      on: [failed, 3]
      message: "${steps.upload.output} ${steps.fetch.rows} ${run.started} ${params.none}"

name: import-orders
steps:
  - id: fetch
    kind: fetch
    with:
      url: https://files.example.org/orders/latest.csv
  - id: validate
    kind: validate
    needs: [fetch]
    with:
      rules:
        - field: id
          check: unique
        - field: email
          check: email
        - field: x
          check: odd
      on_invalid: skip
  - id: strict
    kind: validate
    needs: [validate]
    with:
      rules:
        - {field: total, check: positive}
      max_rejected: 5
  - id: shape
    kind: transform
    needs: [validate]
    with:
      script: error("no")
  - id: stall
    kind: validate
    needs: [validate]
    with:
      rules: [null]

-- How long each step takes, slowest first
SELECT step, count(*) AS runs, round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms, max(duration_ms) AS max_ms
FROM steps
WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY step
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
